sections.h2: Most of the 314 codes are confirmed under Ministry of Textiles, 53 are not

chart.title: 261 of 314 codes are confirmed under Ministry of Textiles ownership
chart.sub: Count of HSN codes, by ownership record.
chart.source: DPIIT Guidebook on HSN mapping, Dec 2025; this annexure.

sections.means: The Ministry of Textiles owns 261 of the 314 codes across 13 labels, or 83%, and Packtech, Geotech and Clothtech confirm all of theirs (100%).
sections.todo: Read each 'No' code as a ministry-ownership flag, not a verdict that the product is not a technical textile.
